summary: Today's four buys (VTI $25, FAST $30, CARG $15, BTC/USD $15) and the RRC rejection still look reasonable on the reasoning and the information available at the time. All four filled near the reference prices: CARG filled at 31.50 and FAST at 51.89, so the fill-anchored 10% stops from L1 hold. Day P&L was -$0.85 (-0.19%) against SPY +0.86%, and the lag is mostly cash drag. Cash is about $280, roughly 47% of equity, because I sized everything down and rejected RRC, so the account is still well short of the owner's mostly-invested target. Resizing was defensible given the unverified earnings dates, the thin CARG liquidity and the BTC volatility, but staying this far under target for another day would need a stronger reason than caution. Day moves on the new positions were small and mixed (CARG -1.0%, FAST +1.0%, BTC +1.0%, VTI +0.2%), which is noise, not evidence. The older DPZ (-1.7%) and WMT (-0.6%) positions are small drawdowns well inside their stops. The staples and defensive tilt (WMT plus DPZ, about 22% of equity) lagged a rising index, which is the expected cost of that tilt. RRC was passed on and is already in the shadow book, so its result can be compared later. No decision looks wrong yet, and one day does not grade any of them.
lessons: L1 (anchor stops to the expected fill) held up today: CARG and FAST filled at 31.50 and 51.89, and the 10% stops were stated against the actual fill, so none of the stop-distance drift seen on 10-20 DPZ occurred. Evidence is still thin, so keep confidence low.

Cash is about 47% of equity after two days of deploying. If the regime filter stays on, the next run should deploy faster into names that already passed review. The owner's one-week goal is only met if sizes grow once the earnings-date checks clear (CARG, FAST) and the mega-cap earnings week passes (VOO add).

Several earnings dates were unverified at decision time (FAST, CARG). The Proposer or News Analyst should confirm them before sizing, so the Portfolio Manager does not shrink positions for lack of data.
